title: Angry Owens gives Mishlove a sore throat over the phone

tellings.quote: He got angry and within minutes I could feel this sensation in my throat
I think he was on the phone with him and he all of a sudden, you know, like stopped being able to breathe or something
tellings.difference: Told secondhand as Mishlove being unable to breathe, rather than a sore throat after Owens grew angry.
tellings.link_reason: The same incident: Owens physically affects Mishlove during a phone call.

as_told.title: Mishlove struggles to breathe while on the phone with Ted Owens

plain: In 1976, a man named Ted Owens, who claimed psychic powers, is said to have hurt a researcher over the phone just by getting angry. The person on the other end was Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic phenomena with a PhD, and he tells it himself: "He got angry and within minutes I could feel this sensation in my throat." Mishlove wrote about Owens in a book called The PK Man, where "PK" stands for psychokinesis, the claimed power of mind over matter. Jesse Michels retells the story secondhand in another episode, with the writer Jason Jorjani as guest. His version is a bit more dramatic: Mishlove suddenly could not breathe during the call. If true, it would suggest that one person's mind can affect another's body at a distance.
